findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "business_credits" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_plans, list_articles, read_page, get_x402_checkout · Private data: business_credits, list_business_orders, get_business_order, place_business_orders, cancel_business_order · Public sink: read_page · Destructive: read_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_plans, list_articles, read_page, get_x402_checkout · Private data: business_credits, list_business_orders, get_business_order, place_business_orders, cancel_business_order · Public sink: read_page · Destructive: read_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
